vat: Prices exclude VAT where VAT applies.
billing: Monthly, in arrears, as one invoice. Annual prepay is 10 months for 12.

plans.name: Free
plans.summary: 25 payments a month, test mode, one site. Stops at the cap; never charges.

plans.name: Starter
plans.summary: 100 payments included, three sites, coupons, webhooks.

plans.name: Growth
plans.summary: 500 payments included, ten sites, subscriptions and instalments.

plans.name: Scale
plans.summary: 2,500 payments included, thirty sites, priority support.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.summary: From $499 a month: custom volume, SLA, onboarding. By quote.

usage.rule: Payments beyond the plan's included allowance pay a percentage of their value, at a rate that falls with the payment's number in the month, with a minimum per payment.

providerFees: Provider fees, bank charges and the transfer tax are paid by the merchant to the provider at cost. WavePay adds no markup to them.

ownKeys.summary: Pass-through: you connect your own provider account; the provider pays you directly and WavePay never holds your money. Only the plan and usage fees above apply.

collection.summary: WavePay collects and pays out. Requires a Reserve Bank payment service provider licence; not offered yet.
